title: Engagement Possible Engagements Autocomplete
description: Extend EngagementSpec with possibleEngagements list and render autocomplete in Engagement UI when Space or Enter are pressed. Wire CAD play idle interaction repl to expose all interactions as possibleEngagements.
summary: Extended EngagementSpec with possibleEngagements and autocomplete UI (Space opens filtered list, Enter selects when open). InteractionRepl idle/active sessions populate possible engagements from interactions/transitions. Playground WindowEngagement and cad play mirror route engagementPossibleSelect commands.
